lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like spatial arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in vertical columns and horizontal rows across the visible mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form discrete nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with highlights on the upper surface and shadowing below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs localized within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Bright yellow-orange irregular mass attached to the apical margin of the first dorsal fin.
